title: sutra_review: fix codex review findings
description:
Fix 4 findings from codex adversarial review of sutra/v1/13 + sutra/v1/14:

1. **[high] Silent error swallowing** — `build_findings` errors discarded via `unwrap_or_default()` at review.rs:83. Malformed rules.toml produces clean-looking review with empty violations. Add degraded-status reporting.
2. **[medium] FCA confidence not propagated** — Convention.confidence not in ConventionViolation or serialized output. Consumers can't distinguish deterministic DD constraints from probabilistic FCA conventions.
3. **[medium] Nondeterministic recommended_reads** — violation sites collected via HashSet, no sort before truncation. Can drop higher-risk sites.
4. **[medium] Tests bypass integration path** — hand-built ReviewFindings only test compute(), not build_findings/handle.

Also: compute() cognitive complexity 31 (threshold 25) — decompose if natural during fixes.

acceptance_criteria.text: build_findings errors surface in ReviewResult (degraded field or explicit error) — not silently swallowed
ConventionViolation includes support and confidence from FCA Convention
recommended_reads violation sites sorted deterministically before truncation
At least one integration test exercises handle() or build_findings with real rules + indexed data
